Quantum 1.27.0 was certified on 2026-09-05. It pins **nucleus v1.23.2**, **quark v1.10.1** and **orbit v1.9.0**, with 22 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.26.2: orbit goes from v1.8.25 to v1.9.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.23.2 and quark stays at v1.10.1. 1 sibling module changes version.
